answer: A new identity enters flagged saffron and must bridge from probation to full standing by solving a sequential delay puzzle: fourteen chained hash steps, like a sonnet where each line only follows from the one before, taking six hours of CPU no parallel hardware can shorten. It also posts a 450 POA bond locked 75 epochs. If peers catch two identities sharing one funding source or hardware fingerprint, both bonds slash 100% and both identities die. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 450,000 POA plus 6,000 CPU-hours, no bulk discount, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back through grading.
